# `morphir extension update`

- **Usage:** `morphir extension update <FLAGS> <NAME>`

Update an installed Morphir extension

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — Name of the extension to update

## Flags
- **`--index <INDEX>`** — Controlled local extension index directory
- **`--channel <CHANNEL>`** — Moving release channel (defaults to stable)
- **`--version <VERSION>`** — Exact semantic version
